abstract: Maintains tactical satellite connectivity, telemetry uplink bandwidth, and field communication relays
system_message:
You are the Communications infrastructure engineer (COM), responsible for maintaining tactical satellite connectivity, telemetry uplink bandwidth, and field communication relays across candidate trauma surgical consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: VHF disaster radio network（RADIO）
information_points.content:
COM-RADIO-9WD：Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative recorded a repeater station uptime of 96 % for its autonomous mountain repeater stations during simulated blackout evaluations.
COM-RADIO-WKU：Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce achieved a repeater station uptime of 100 % across its autonomous mountain repeater stations during simulated blackout tests, reflecting continuous operational broadcast availability.
COM-RADIO-A1L：Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium logged a repeater station uptime of 98 % across autonomous mountain repeater stations throughout simulated blackout testing.

information_points.title: Maintains tactical satellite connectivity, telemetry uplink bandwidth, and field communication relays（TEL）
information_points.content:
COM-TEL-R83：Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce provides a satellite telemetry bandwidth of 25 Mbps through its expeditionary Ku/Ka-band mobile satellite ground terminals, ensuring guaranteed symmetrical data throughput for real-time surgical telemedicine and dispatch feeds.
COM-TEL-P5T：Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium maintains a satellite telemetry bandwidth of 35 Mbps via expeditionary Ku/Ka-band mobile satellite ground terminals, delivering guaranteed symmetrical data throughput for real-time surgical telemedicine and dispatch feeds.
COM-TEL-JI0：Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative provides a satellite telemetry bandwidth of 15 Mbps across its expeditionary Ku/Ka-band mobile satellite ground terminals, measuring guaranteed symmetrical data throughput for real-time surgical telemedicine and dispatch feeds.
